text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon sensed that Rice Shower 
would become an even tougher rival in the 
Kikuka Sho. Her declaration of war sent 
the crowd into a roar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile... even while showing her 
frustration at the press conference, 
Matikane Tannhauser demonstrated strong 
resolve for the upcoming Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her positive words at the press conference 
struck a chord with the audience. 
Matikanetannhauser has no intention of 
losing in the upcoming Kikuka-sho either.
